In `packages/compiler-sfc/src/style/pluginScoped.ts`, the scoped-CSS nesting transform now also wraps declarations (and comments) inside nested at-rules — like `@media`/`@container` — into a `&` host rule via `extractAndWrapNodes`, so the `[data-v-*]` scoping attribute gets applied there just like at the top level. When postcss then visits the newly prepended `&` rules inside those at-rules, `rewriteSelector` injects the scope attribute, producing `@media ... { &[data-v-xxx] { ... } }` as expected.
